content: Pakistan home healthcare: Sehat Kahani HHC (nursing, doctor home visits, therapies, dietitian, mental health; 3 care plans; central physician monitoring via app; online portal for family; 24/7 support). Dawaai home services (nursing in Karachi only, vitals, wound dressing, doctor house calls, lab). Marham (PMC-verified doctors, appointment booking, home visits list, reviews, helpline booking). InstaCare (virtual nursing + HR/credential software). Pattern: verified credentials + reviews + phone/WhatsApp + cash payments.
